meta_title: SayOVA – Talk to AI from your wrist
meta_description: SayOVA is a realtime voice assistant for Wear OS. Talk naturally, interrupt whenever you like and read along on your watch, with Google Gemini or OpenAI and your own key.
hero_title: Talk to AI from your wrist.
hero_lead: SayOVA is a voice assistant for your Wear OS watch that you simply talk to. Interrupt it like a person, read along on the screen, and let it set a timer, check the weather or prepare a message on your phone.
hero_requirements: For Wear OS 3 and newer, with your own key from Google Gemini or OpenAI.
demo_caption: SayOVA's own example conversation, in its real voice.
talk_intro: There are no commands to learn and no wake word. Tap the orb, say what you need, and talk over the answer if it goes the wrong way.
f_interrupt_text: Your voice streams live to Gemini Live or OpenAI Realtime, and the answer plays while it is being generated. Talk over it at any time, like you would with a person, and SayOVA listens. Or tap the orb.
f_interrupt_alt: SayOVA speaking, the orb filling the watch screen
f_read_text: No need to ask twice: both sides of the conversation appear on the screen, and the part of the answer you have already heard is bright. In a meeting or a library, switch the voice off and read the answers instead.
f_read_alt: The live transcript on the watch, the heard part of the answer bright
f_timer_text: Timers, alarms (every weekday, if you like), notes and the battery, without leaving the conversation. For anything current, like the news, opening hours or last night's score, SayOVA searches the web.
f_timer_alt: A conversation with a running timer shown under the orb
f_phone_said: “Text Lena on WhatsApp that I'm ten minutes late.”
f_phone_text: SayOVA reads the message back, and after your yes it waits on your phone in WhatsApp, ready for you to send. The same works for SMS, e-mail and other messengers, for calendar events and for routes. SayOVA never sends anything in your name.
f_phone_alt: A WhatsApp message prepared on the phone, in SayOVA's history
f_watch_text: SayOVA uses your location, heart rate, steps, calendar, music, contacts, apps or notifications only for the question you ask, after you allowed it once, and shows an icon while it does. You choose which of them it may use at all.
f_watch_alt: A weather question in the history, answered for the current location
f_interp_text: Pick two of 21 languages and hold the watch between you and the person you are talking to. SayOVA says everything in the other language, nothing else, and shows both sides as text.
f_interp_alt: The interpreter, set to English and Spanish
f_memory_said: “Remember that I have a dog called Bruno.”
f_memory_text: Every later conversation knows. SayOVA keeps only what you ask it to, on the watch, and you can read or delete each fact in the settings.
f_memory_alt: Facts SayOVA remembers, listed in the settings

setup_intro: No companion app, no account and no typing on a tiny keyboard.
step1_text: Before you set anything up, it plays an example conversation and shows you around.
step2_title: Scan the code with your phone
step2_text: Your watch shows a QR code. Your phone's camera opens the page that connects the two.
step3_text: The key is encrypted in your phone's browser for your watch alone. Our server only passes on data it cannot read.
step4_text: If the six digits on your watch match the ones on your phone, tap the check mark. That's it.
setup_key_link: How to get an API key
setup_watch_alt: The QR code on the watch
setup_phone_alt: The page on the phone where you paste your key
fact_key_d: SayOVA talks to Google Gemini or OpenAI with your own API key, and your provider bills you for what you use. SayOVA itself is a one-time purchase, with no subscription, no ads and no in-app purchases.
fact_cost_d: With Gemini about 1–2 cents a minute, with OpenAI about 2–11 cents. SayOVA shows a running estimate and statistics for every month, and warns you as you near a monthly budget you set.
fact_privacy_d: Your voice goes straight from the watch to your provider. There is no SayOVA server in between, no account and no tracking. The key is stored encrypted on the watch, and the history stays there too.
fact_open_d: The source code is open under the Apache License 2.0, so you can read exactly what SayOVA does with your voice and your key.
fact_req_d: A watch with Wear OS 3 or newer and a microphone, Wi-Fi or LTE, and an API key. The Gemini API is for users aged 18 and over.
fact_usage_alt: SayOVA's usage screen: this month's cost against the budget
d_1: Start talking from a tile, a complication on your watch face or a double press of the side button.
d_2: Keeps talking with the screen off, with an icon on the watch face.
d_3: Works over the watch speaker or Bluetooth headphones.
d_4: 40 voices to listen to before you choose, and six personalities, from concise to detailed.
d_5: The history stays on the watch for as long as you choose, and any conversation can be continued later.
d_6: In 13 languages, which you can set apart from the watch's own.
d_7: A step-by-step guide with pictures for every function, also opened from the watch's settings.
